Definition: support or (by implication) ability, i.e. (direct) help, (in purpose) an undertaking, (intellectual) understanding
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tûwshîyâh is the word for sound wisdom, help. In Job 5:12, that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. That is the sense it carries through all 12 of its occurrences.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sound wisdom is not cleverness; it is the help God gives to those who ask Him for the way. That is why I come back to tûwshîyâh whenever I need to remember what is true.
